firearms-damage-timed-buff.head: 55f1b05b5b8e86cad4613b81e347e90e77920c0d
firearms-damage-timed-buff.scope: Stock Firearms Skill raised Ballistic Damage by 25 and restored it after 20 seconds. The own-view IS debit was 20 at baseline.

timed-inner-strength-cost-buff.head: 55f1b05b5b8e86cad4613b81e347e90e77920c0d
timed-inner-strength-cost-buff.scope: Stock Efficiency displayed +15% for 300 seconds. Own-view IS debits were 17 instead of 20 for Firearms Skill and 9 instead of 10 for Repair RSI, with normal costs restored after expiry.

physical-defense-timed-buff.head: 55f1b05b5b8e86cad4613b81e347e90e77920c0d
physical-defense-timed-buff.scope: Stock Enhanced Dodge raised Melee and Ballistic Defense by 47. Thrown Defense stayed at baseline. Both applied defenses expired at 300 seconds.

corpsman-accuracy-timed-buffs.head: 55f1b05b5b8e86cad4613b81e347e90e77920c0d
corpsman-accuracy-timed-buffs.scope: Stock Combat Training raised Melee Accuracy by 64. Weapons Boost sent a removal for the same record and added 64 Ballistic Accuracy. Weapons Boost returned to baseline at natural expiry.

direct-maximum-health-buffs.head: 55f1b05b5b8e86cad4613b81e347e90e77920c0d
direct-maximum-health-buffs.scope: Stock Bolster Health ranks 1 through 3 and Upgrade Health applied +50, +200, +500 and +500 to the 6,200 baseline. Own-view maxima and off/on records show replacement and no overlap. Bolster rank 1 also cast on a friendly recipient.
